title: Payload Needle — Error Aggregation Panel + Replay Controls
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Operators and engineers need a compact way to triage recurring failures across high-volume routes. Current Console views show lists and raw traces, but it is time-consuming to: correlate error taxonomy across retries, compare payload diffs across repeated attempts, and do targeted replays without leaving the console.

Goal: Design a consolidated panel (Payload Needle) that aggregates failed requests by normalized error class, surfaces a representative payload 'needle' per cluster, provides a lightweight payload diff viewer for recent retries, and exposes one-click replay controls (dry-run / live replay) with context-aware defaults. The panel should be embeddable in route and model dashboards and work in both Hosted and Private Console variants.

Success metrics: reduce median triage time for recurring errors by ~30% (tracked through time-to-close in issue links), increase use of in-console replays by platform SREs, and reduce ad-hoc investigation attachments to external tools.
acceptance_criteria: Panel shows grouped error clusters with normalized taxonomy and counts for last 24h, 7d, 30d
Each cluster includes a representative payload (needle) with a confidence score and link to list of matching requests
Inline diff viewer highlights parameter-level differences between up to 3 recent retries with tokenized/structured comparison for JSON payloads
Replay controls support: dry-run (no external side effects), simulated latency injection, and live replay with rate-limited throttle
Access control respects existing RBAC; replay buttons are disabled for roles without 'run-replay' privilege
Mobile and narrow viewport: panel collapses into a stack with critical info (error class, count, last seen) and an action menu
Performance: initial render of top 10 clusters < 350ms on typical console session under production telemetry
Unit and e2e design handoff docs provided for engineering (Figma tokens, interaction spec, aria labels)
tasks: Finalize error normalization taxonomy with SRE and backend (map 120+ error strings into ~18 classes)
Design representative-pick heuristic and fallback UI for non-deterministic selection
Prototype payload diff UI and validate with 3 SREs using anonymized failures
Create accessibility spec and keyboard flows for replay controls
Handoff to ENG: prepare component props, edge cases, and API contract (grouping window, sample size, replay endpoints)
Prepare QA checklist and privacy checklist for Private deployments
